correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the formal exponential walk generating function product Q_m,i Q_n,j, first-exit expansion log Q=2z+F_i+F_{m-1-i} through order m, and extraction of the multiplicities of four side distances by successive nonzero leading coefficients. The complement-to-(m-1) constraint distinguishes the short-side pair in non-squares. After dividing away its Q factor the long-side nearest distance is determined. Orbit equality and stable upper bound follow. Rooted walk-tree lower bounds distinguish adjacent near-central long coordinate and the (1,0)/(0,1) short/long-direction pair. The stabilization convention correctly counts initial uniform round 0. Independently implemented 1-WL and orbit classification on 165 rectangular grids (2<=m<=12, n<=21), all exact depths and orbit partitions matched. Prior package checker supports 539 cases, but neither finite test is an infinite proof. Boundary m=2 and square m=2 both checked.
